process.title: Pre-list strategy & staging
process.summary: We walk the house with our stager and build a room-by-room prep list ranked by return per dollar. Trades are booked from our roster, not yours.
details: Room-by-room prep list with cost/return estimates
Professional staging — furniture and styling included, not billed
Trade coordination: paint, repair, deep clean, landscaping
Pre-list inspection so surprises never arrive on offer day

process.title: 3D tour, drone & architectural photography
process.summary: Full media day: architectural stills, twilight exteriors, 4K walkthrough video, drone, and a Matterport 3D tour that lets out-of-town buyers shop at midnight.
details: Architectural photography with flambient blending
4K cinematic walkthrough + vertical social cut-downs
Drone exteriors and neighbourhood context shots
Matterport 3D tour with dollhouse view and floor plans

process.title: Targeted Meta & Google campaigns
process.summary: Your listing runs as a paid campaign, not just an MLS entry — geo-targeted at GTA move-out intent and retargeted to everyone who viewed the 3D tour.
details: Geo-fenced Meta campaign targeting GTA relocation intent
Google search coverage on neighbourhood + street-name queries
Retargeting pool built from 3D tour and video viewers
Weekly performance report: reach, tour opens, saved listings

process.title: VIP preview & agent-only opening
process.summary: Before the public sees it, the listing goes to our buyer database and a curated agent list — so week one opens with warm demand instead of cold traffic.
details: Coming-soon email to our active buyer database
Agent-only preview with feedback collection
Broker open with catered mid-week window
Public open house Saturday and Sunday, both agents on site

process.title: Offer day strategy & negotiation
process.summary: We set the offer date, qualify every agent who registers, and negotiate with a written escalation plan you approve in advance — no decisions made under pressure.
details: Offer date set to concentrate demand into one window
Every registered agent qualified for financing and conditions
Written escalation plan agreed with you before offers open
Post-firm coordination through to closing day
